subject: Linguagens e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Empregar, nas interações sociais, a variedade e o estilo de língua adequados à situação comunicativa, ao(s) interlocutor(es) e ao gênero do discurso, respeitando os usos das línguas por esse(s) interlocutor(es) e sem preconceito linguístico.

components.description_pt: Escolher linguagem e estilo apropriados ao público, propósito e contexto da comunicação
components.description_en: Choose language and style appropriate to the audience, purpose, and context of communication
components.cc_component_description: Choose language and style appropriate to the audience, purpose, and context of communication

components.description_pt: Ajustar registro de linguagem entre formal e informal conforme contexto e público
components.description_en: Adjust language register between formal and informal based on context and audience
components.cc_component_description: Adjust language register between formal and informal based on context and audience

components.description_pt: Respeitar os usos linguísticos dos interlocutores sem expressar preconceito linguístico
components.description_en: Respect the language uses of interlocutors without expressing linguistic prejudice

cc_matches.description: Use knowledge of language and its conventions when writing, speaking, reading, or listening.

Differentiate between contexts that call for formal English (e.g., presenting ideas) and situations where informal discourse is appropriate (e.g., small-group discussion); use formal English when appropriate to task and situation.
